title: Notify Claude Code of CI results through one path

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage report

Verdict: Caught (PostToolUse path); the Claude Stop `decision: "block"` assertion was not reached by this fault.

Story and revision: SEED-423 `notify-claude-code-of-ci-through-one-path` (plan 809), revision 66e36036c16c4d9f3d52ac3d3105c48045910395 on claude/notify-claude-code-of-ci-results-through-one-pat. Promise (key example 2): with CI pending at the end of a Claude Code turn, a later CI failure is added once by the ordinary PostToolUse or Stop hook at the next interaction.

Fault: Distribution/src/skills/dough-execute-plan/scripts/ci-host-hook.mjs, selectCiEvents, inserted `if (host === "claude") continue;` as the first statement of the `for (const binding of readdirSync(bindings))` loop. This skips the Claude event read. Fixtures and assertions were left unchanged.

Scratch checkout: a detached worktree at the selected revision, set up with `npm ci` on Node v24.21.0, which matches .node-version. Before the probe, `git status --porcelain` was empty.

Focused command: `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR bash scripts/test.sh Distribution/tests/skills/dough-execute-plan/ci-claude-lifecycle.test.mjs Distribution/tests/skills/dough-execute-plan/ci-host-hook-process.test.mjs`, run with OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_TIMES and OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_OUTCOMES so the run shows that both files executed.

Baseline: exit 0, and both files reported `passed` (about 1.2 s each).

Independent witness: a scratch script outside the checkout. It used the maintained ci-host-hook test fixtures to attach a Claude mailbox, publish CI_FAILURE, then call the real hook process with Stop and then with PostToolUse.
- Unfaulted: Stop returned `{"decision":"block","reason":"...CI_FAILURE runId 42..."}` and PostToolUse returned hookSpecificOutput with runId 43.
- Faulted: attach still returned its message, but Stop returned `{}` and PostToolUse returned `{}`. The CI failure was never added on either path, so the promised behavior went wrong on the intended path.

Faulted focused run: exit 1, and both files failed.
- Catching assertion on the promised PostToolUse path: ci-host-hook-process.test.mjs "Claude Code redelivers an event when the hook process is interrupted before output completes". `assertOutputShape` at line 70, `assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(delivered), ["hookSpecificOutput"])`, failed with actual `[]` against expected `['hookSpecificOutput']`. It was called from proveInterruptedDelivery at line 46.
- The same file's "a symlink-equivalent entry path still parses stdin and delivers CI diagnostic output" also failed, at line 90, on the same assertion shape.
- ci-claude-lifecycle.test.mjs failed earlier, at line 35: a TypeError reading `additionalContext` of the readiness output (CI_MONITOR_READY). That test never reached its CI_FAILURE boundary assertion (line 72) or its Stop `decision === "block"` assertion (line 92).
- Caught is therefore claimed only for the Claude PostToolUse delivery of a later CI failure. This fault gives no assertion verdict on the Claude Stop-block output, although the witness did observe Stop going wrong.

Restoration: restored with `git checkout --` on the file in the scratch worktree. `cmp` against a saved pre-probe copy reported the file identical, and `git status --porcelain` was empty again. The same focused command then exited 0 with both files `passed` (1.1 s and 0.9 s). The scratch worktree was then removed and pruned.

Next proof action: none is needed for the PostToolUse path. To get a verdict on the Claude Stop path, run a separate one-fault probe that suppresses only the Claude Stop `decision: "block"` output and check whether ci-claude-lifecycle.test.mjs line 92 catches it. The secondary key example 3 (retirement) was not re-probed; execution already observed it once.

Cost: test runtime about 5.4 s of per-file job time across three runs, excluding `npm ci`. Human effort: none. Agent effort: about 17 tool calls (count only). Invocation-to-report elapsed: 90049 ms. Start time: 2026-11-24 16:22:13 +08.

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision 66e36036c16c4d9f3d52ac3d3105c48045910395; verdict Caught; no follow-up. The promise is delivery through the PostToolUse or Stop hook, and the maintained PostToolUse assertion caught the fault on that path. The Stop-only probe would add no proof the promise requires.
